```yaml
name: UI Core Components Tests

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  update-playwright:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install

      - name: Update @playwright/test to version 1.54.2
        run: yarn add @playwright/test@1.54.2 --dev

      - name: Update Playwright browser installation to 1.54.2
        run: npx playwright install 1.54.2

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
          git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
          git add package.json yarn.lock
          git commit -m "chore(ui-core-components): bump @playwright/test to 1.54.2"

      - name: Push changes
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@v0.6.0
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: main

  e2e-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: update-playwright
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install

      - name: Run E2E tests
        run: yarn test:e2e
```

Please note that this workflow assumes you have an `e2e` script defined in your `package.json` that runs your end-to-end tests using Playwright. You will need to adjust the `yarn test:e2e` command according to your actual test configuration. Additionally, ensure that the `mysql-nightly-e2e.yml`, `playwright-mysql-e2e.yml`, `playwright-postgresql-e2e.yml`, and `postgresql-nightly-e2e.yml` workflows are updated to use Playwright version 1.54.2 as well.
